Chapter 560: Chapter 11: Fifteen Years Later (Subscribe Please)_2

Chapter 560: Chapter 11: Fifteen Years Later (Subscribe Please)_2

Rather than laboriously exploring opportunities everywhere, it’s better to directly seek out those who have found such opportunities.

In the Main Universe, if one wishes to hunt a Ninth Rank, even just at its early stage, one needs to consider many factors, such as whether the alien’s power group would provide support.

The most important thing is, even if one kills a Ninth Rank, the avatar is most likely what you would destroy, and it would not carry any excessively precious treasures.

But in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, it’s different.

Those Ninth Rank Myriad Layer Realm strong ones who have survived up to now, in the eyes of those alien strong ones from Million Heavy Realm and Ten Million Heavy Realm, are nothing but walking treasure troves, and killing just one can yield considerable rewards.

Even Lin Yuan, who tries as much as possible not to flock to places of opportunity, has still collected quite a lot, not to mention the other strong ones?

...

In addition, the outer area is the smallest, so it is the first to be swept through.

Lin Yuan and Xilan actively moved towards the core area and thus avoided the first wave of the hunters’ sweep.

“Once you enter the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, you can only leave when it closes, if you are in the outer area, then you are actively expelled.”

Lin Yuan spoke with a slightly reflective tone.

Although there are 333 entrances to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm in the Main Universe, those are only entrances, not exits.

Once the closing day arrives, if not situated in the outer area, one would be left inside the realm, and the fate awaiting them would be death by the realm’s forces.

“Galaxy Master, these past fifteen years, you must have made some breakthroughs, right?” Xilan engaged in some conversation, full of curiosity.

If it were any other Ninth Rank strong one, Xilan would not ask such a question. Fifteen years? A breakthrough in just fifteen years?

For the long-lived Ninth Rank strong beings, fifteen years is not even enough for a nap.

But this is Lin Yuan.

Xilan could say she had personally witnessed the speed of Lin Yuan’s growth.

Decades ago, Lin Yuan was still fighting those Eighth Layer beings on the Medium-Sized Otherworldly Battlefield.

It was not long before he could repulse someone like the Maduo Traveler, a Ninth Rank strong one close to the Million Heavy Realm.

And that was what happened fifteen years ago.

Now, another fifteen years have passed.

Lin Yuan can only be stronger.

“Indeed, I have made breakthroughs.”

Lin Yuan smiled, not denying it.

“This is too freakish…” Xilan sighed.

Watching the once younger figure swiftly catch up, surpass, and widen the gap, left Xilan with complicated feelings.

To live in the same era as the Galaxy Master, she wasn’t sure if it was either a fortune or a misfortune.

…

Though Xilan did not continue to inquire, as doing so would seem somewhat ‘inappropriate.’

Nevertheless, Lin Yuan still had flashes in his mind about many breakthroughs he had achieved over these fifteen years.

The first was making headway in the Rule of Time, an achievement most Ninth Rank beings could not possibly possess.

Even if a Ninth Rank being was lucky enough to make headway in the Rule of Time, it would be at the Ninth Stage Peak, when no further advancement was possible, coupled with good fortune, after a long accumulation releasing suddenly, barely achieving it.

Lin Yuan stepping into the Rule of Time in just twenty to thirty years of being a Ninth Rank was indeed incredible.

Entering the Rule of Time did not significantly enhance direct combat power, but its auxiliary effects were exceptionally rare and valuable.

Secondly was the derivation and expansion of Spatial Layers. Over fifteen years, Lin Yuan’s Spatial Layers had developed and expanded to 198,000 layers.

Even within the Hundred-Thousand Heavy Realm, Lin Yuan’s Spatial Layers would not be considered weak.

198,000 layers of Spatial Layers… combined with Lin Yuan’s world-spanning over a million miles within his Inner World, layer upon layer accumulating, Lin Yuan’s direct combat strength could likely skyrocket to the two million layer level.

Of course, that’s just comparable fighting strength face-to-face. In other aspects, Lin Yuan was still far less than those of the two million layer strong ones.

Such as mastery over numerous Spatial Layers and the instant seizing of Spatial Layer quantities.

Besides, Lin Yuan occasionally continued to comprehend the body of a Supreme Being, aiming to understand more paths of the Demonic Evolution Path.

Firstly, these paths of the Demonic Evolution Path were beneficial to Lin Yuan, even at the Ninth Rank, they could still be of help.

Secondly, Lin Yuan wanted to continue elevating the ranks of his Demon Jade Tower Members.

After the core members of the Moyu Tower, came the Sequence Members.

Compared to ordinary members, core members, and Sequence Members in the Demon Jade Tower, they began to truly hold power.

If Lin Yuan could become a Demon Jade Tower Member, he might gain certain authority over the Demon Jade Space.

In doing so,

even if Alien Strong Ones in the future condensed the Magic Jade Mark and became ordinary members of the Magic Jade Tower, using the Magic Jade Mark to descend into the Demon Jade Space,

Lin Yuan could leverage his Sequence Disciple authority to expel them.

This would prevent the Alien Strong Ones from benefiting from the opportunities available in the Demon Jade Space. Lin Yuan knew well how precious and rare the treasures in the Nine Floors Dark Tower’s reward repository were.

He even speculated that by continuously upgrading his membership level inside the Magic Jade Tower, he might someday be able to take control of the Magic Jade Tower and become its new master.

Although the Magic Jade Tower had declined following the disappearance of the Demonic Jade Tower Master, with many members hiding scattered,

even a weakened camel is bigger than a horse. The lure of any single layer’s reward repository in the Nine Floors Dark Tower could light up Lin Yuan’s eyes, let alone the Magic Jade Tower itself?

The final aspect concerned the absorption of the liquid inside the Mysterious Gourd.

Now Lin Yuan had already absorbed the sixth kind of blue liquid and had greatly progressed in absorbing it. His Inner World had even reached a size of one hundred and eighty million square miles.

To understand, opening successive Spatial Layers amplifies the potency of each layer in his Inner World.

The impact on Lin Yuan’s power was nothing short of transformative.

Of course, an Inner World spanning one hundred eighty million square miles was only achievable by Lin Yuan’s True Body. As for the Taiyang Divine Spirit situated in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm,

the Inner World was still the same size as before his entry because Lin Yuan couldn’t possibly send the Mysterious Gourd to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm for the Taiyang Divine Spirit to absorb.

In fact, there was no need to send it; it could completely be transferred through the “Door to the Myriad Realms.”

While moving between worlds, he could expend World-Breaking Origin Force to send items from the Main World to the world he was traversing.

Similarly, while in the Main World, items could be instantly transferred between Lin Yuan’s True Body and the Primordial Spirit through the “Door to the Myriad Realms.”

It only required the expenditure of World-Breaking Origin Force.

As for the isolation of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm? If it could traverse dimensional walls, what was the Xuanhuang Secret Realm compared to that?

Yet Lin Yuan still chose not to do so because if the Mysterious Gourd appeared in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, there was a risk of losing it.

What if, while the Taiyang Divine Spirit held the Mysterious Gourd, it encountered a supreme being Lin Yuan couldn’t resist, or some peril inherent to the Xuanhuang Secret Realm itself, and lost the Mysterious Gourd? Wouldn’t that be heartbreaking?

“World-Breaking Origin Force?”

Lin Yuan breathed a sigh of relief. Fifteen years ago, he had amassed seventy-one strands of World-Breaking Origin Force.

Now, Lin Yuan’s tally of World-Breaking Origin Force had reached an impressive one hundred and twenty strands.

With such a hefty amount, Lin Yuan could even “custom-order” a trip through realms.

It only required the expenditure of one hundred strands of World-Breaking Origin Force to allow the Door to the Myriad Realms to select a world for traversal based on his set conditions.

…

“If it wasn’t for the need to conserve energy for travel, I’d want to undertake a traversal right now,” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

When approaching a critical breakthrough, Lin Yuan was hesitant to traverse, fearing it might delay his progress.

But now? It was a time when he needed to accumulate substantial time, opening a layer after layer in space—time being the main expenditure.

It was arguably the best opportunity for Lin Yuan to traverse.

Unfortunately, he was now in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm, and to quickly understand the reason behind the ‘calling sensation,’ he decided to postpone his chance of traversal.

After all, there was no real harm in waiting.

There would be no loss to his World-Breaking Origin Force.

“Only five or six years until reaching the core area,”

Xilan couldn’t help but mutter softly; he also wanted to personally explore the core area of the Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

“Exactly,”

Lin Yuan nodded.

As the two hastened on their way,

Rumble!

A terrifying celestial fluctuation came from a distant place, affecting layer upon layer of space.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan’s expression changed slightly as he looked towards the source of the celestial fluctuation.
